Name: Sebastian_Girl Dialogue changes
Author: KeionDryke
Description:
Here's the dialogue changes to go along with Sebastian_Girl by Adarin http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/463/?

[size=4][u]Installation

[/u][/size]Unzip files into you Content folder in your Stardew Valley directory
Let it over write
Don't forget to back up the original files

To uninstall, just put the original files back and over write.

Any missed dialogue, please let me know

I will not be making a patch for t his to go along with the other dialogue changes I made unless someone specifically asks because I will be making a combined mod of all of them put together. (so unless you decided to play with only certain ones, a patch isn't needed)
